confidence_notes: Recent [CityCost](https://citycost.org/byron-bay/) and [Drink Map](https://drinkmap.net/byron-bay/drink-prices) observations approximate July 2026 food and drink prices. Beer is estimated as a 425 mL schooner. Accommodation estimates are model-based and particularly uncertain because of seasonal demand and limited basic-room supply.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on Byron Bay's position as a popular Australian coastal destination, with the Gold Coast and Noosa as broad regional comparisons.
